interface.longDescription:
Version 0.5.2. Operator is the Codex plugin for Agent Operator Kit: a human-supervised cockpit for real projects, including feature-scoped dependency graphs, a capacity-bounded runnable frontier, and optional advisory model selection. On the first Operator prompt it runs a read-only project preflight and recommends the correct setup, repair, migration, or continuation path.

Use it to coordinate feature chats, isolated worktrees, reusable lane roles, task packets, handoffs, memory, roadmap items, feedback intake, planning, design review, UX audits, journeys, and incubation. Model selection is off by default, applies no settings, and uses only reviewed project-local inputs. V5.2 requires no signing authority, Keychain credentials, proof broker, trusted host, lease, or heartbeat loop.
